description: This shell script defines a set of tests related to Git repository behaviors, particularly focusing on commit graph fetch scenarios, commit-graph creation, and alternates configuration.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines a test case expecting successful execution.

methods.name: test_commit
methods.description: Creates a git commit within the specified repository.

methods.name: test_path_is_file
methods.description: Checks if a given path is a regular file.

methods.name: test_must_fail
methods.description: Asserts that the given command fails.

methods.name: test_grep
methods.description: Searches for a pattern in a file.

methods.name: test_line_count
methods.description: Checks the number of lines matching a pattern in a file.
